seal_before_join_basis: Audited bound sequential producer and GT-free feature/frame hashes; no independent wall-clock instrumentation of supervised reads
scope: This tests which cached individual cues distinguish sparse eligible manual identities on a fixed exploratory FIT population. CV history may inherit original tracker errors; no ego compensation or dynamics validity is established. AUROC does not establish an operating threshold, assignment improvement, learned fusion value, generalization or novelty. Current five-mode experiment remains a memory intervention; geometry remains nonlearned. Geometry AUROC alone does not establish information incremental to appearance. Paired ranking tables are descriptive complementarity checks on sparse eligible manual identities and a conditional known-reference subset, not deployed complete-candidate top1 or assignment gain. Positive-negative pair comparisons may share endpoints and queries.
